Name: Shirtless Sebby and Shane
Author: Blossom5280
Description:
[center]﻿Have ya ever wanted Sebastian to be shirtless at the beach?
Me too i get ya!
Here's a simple mod to make Sebastian's beach sprite and portrait shirtless! Now includes Shane!

Plus support for Nyapu and OhoDavi portraits!

[/center][u]Installation: [/u]Simply move the unzipped mod to your Mods folder.

[u]Configuration: [/u]GMCM is recommended, or you can edit the config.json that is generated when you first load the mod.

Options to enable Shane and Seb individually, and choice between Vanilla, Nyapu, and OhoDavi portraits. Chest hair option for Shane.

[u]Compatible with:

[/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu[/url] - includes portraits to match

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]OhoDavi[/url] (CP version) (+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31999]1.6 update[/url]) - includes portraits to match

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute[/url] - works in both latest and legacy versions. Slight mismatch with cute portraits, especially Sebby who has shorter hair in Seasonal Cute.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url] - works but only for vanilla variants at this time. Slight mismatch with DSV vanilla portraits - our beach Seb will not have piercings and glasses, and Shane's chest hair may look different (enable chest hair for the closest match).


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7325]Girafarig’s Beach Outfits[/url] - our shirtless version of Seb will take precedence if enabled.


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] - Won’t break the game but no integration. Shirtless sprites will be used, but portrait is whatever you select in Portraiture (including ours in the ‘vanilla’ portrait set). Note that if you want to use our shirtless sprites with custom portraits in Portraiture, they need to be named with “_IslandSouth” rather than “_Beach”.
